title: ジャパンカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa has finally reached the stage she dreamed of from the very beginning… The Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her talent, confidence, and especially her desire to entertain her fans is what got her here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads for the race, excited to face off against Special Week and powerful athletes from abroad.
